answer: Resist Sybils with escalating bonds tied to hardware: the k-th identity from one operator must lock k squared units, so ten clones lock 385 units against one honest agent's 1. A ferrous secure element binds each bond to a single device, so one machine cannot mint many identities. A gale of cloud clones still pays the full quadratic price per identity, and a tundra of idle unendorsed clones earns nothing, because rewards need three independent endorsers. Guard the failure mode of endorsement cartels by capping each endorser at five endorsements per epoch and slashing colluding bonds.
